patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with a central, prominent search interface that dynamically integrates into the sticky header on scroll.
Consistent use of multi-column grid layouts for displaying destination cards, typically 3-4 columns wide, ensuring visual consistency across content listings.
Clear typographic hierarchy with bold, medium-sized headings for section titles and a clean, legible sans-serif for body text, maintaining readability across various content types.
A vibrant, energetic blue (#1875ec) is used as the primary accent and CTA color, providing clear visual cues against a predominantly neutral white and light grey background.

Sticky header with a significant transformation: the large search bar and main navigation collapse into a compact, fixed top bar with a solid background, integrating the search input and navigation links as the user scrolls.

Destination cards feature a consistent layout: a hero image, a bold title, a brief description, and a prominent 'Book Now' button, presented in a clean, white-background container with subtle rounding.

technique_notes: The site employs a scroll-triggered animation system (likely using CSS keyframes and/or JavaScript) to transform the header. Initially, a large hero section contains a prominent search bar and primary navigation. Upon scrolling, the hero image scales down and moves up, while the search bar and primary navigation collapse into a compact, sticky header with a solid background, integrating the search input and navigation links.
Cards and interactive elements consistently use subtle rounded corners and soft shadows for a lifted, approachable feel.
Full-width sections alternate between white and light grey backgrounds to visually separate content blocks and provide clear content segmentation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are moderately large and bold (~2-3x body text) for clear section breaks, while body text is clean and legible, often accompanied by smaller, uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are consistently applied to interactive elements like buttons, search inputs, and content cards, contributing to an approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density; sections are separated by generous vertical padding, while content within cards and grids is more compact but maintains good readability.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the dynamic, transforming sticky header. It seamlessly transitions from a large, integrated search and navigation area within the hero to a compact, functional top bar upon scroll, effectively maximizing initial screen real estate while maintaining accessibility to key functions.
